commit 5c15982b4e770679f20b7bd68028ea36402ec376
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Jul 17 22:54:48 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Jul 17 22:54:48 2024 +0000

    Bug 1908558 - Fix building with --disable-mapi. r=dandarnell
    
    
    When --disable-mapi is set in mozconfig, the build fails with a Python KeyError due
    to buildconfig.substs not having a "MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT" key.
    
    Using defined() here correctly handles non-present key.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D216882

diff --git a/mailnews/addrbook/src/components.conf b/mailnews/addrbook/src/components.conf
index a648b253cb0..032b6ce2bcc 100644
--- a/mailnews/addrbook/src/components.conf
+++ b/mailnews/addrbook/src/components.conf
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ if buildconfig.substs["OS_ARCH"] == "Darwin":
         },
     ]
 
-if buildconfig.substs["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT" and buildconfig.substs["MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT"]:
+if buildconfig.substs["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT" and defined("MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT"):
     Classes += [
         {
             "cid": "{9cc57822-0599-4c47-a399-1c6fa185a05c}",
diff --git a/mailnews/import/src/components.conf b/mailnews/import/src/components.conf
index 593cd27bb94..1f9a81ddb91 100644
--- a/mailnews/import/src/components.conf
+++ b/mailnews/import/src/components.conf
@@ -48,7 +48,7 @@ if buildconfig.substs["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
         },
     ]
 
-    if buildconfig.substs["MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT"]:
+    if defined("MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT"):
         Classes += [
             {
                 "cid": "{1db469a0-8b00-11d3-a206-00a0cc26da63}",
